housing.summary: Numbeo reports an August 2026 average of PLN 3,155 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in Gdynia city centre (source_url: https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/in/Gdynia). The usual Polish security deposit is 1-2 months' rent, most often one month (source_url: https://domkaspot.com/blog/rental-deposit-laws-poland-rights-obligations). Otodom has a dedicated Gdynia rental-apartment portal (source_url: https://www.otodom.pl/pl/oferty/wynajem/mieszkanie/gdynia).

banking.summary: PKO Bank Polski says an applicant can open an account at a branch with an ID card or passport and lists the required applicant data; a taxpayer of another country should also prepare that country's tax identification number (source_url: https://www.pkobp.pl/en/how-to-open-a-personal-account).
required_docs: foreign tax identification number if a taxpayer in another country

schools.summary: Einstein International School in Gdynia states that it is an authorized IB World School offering the International Baccalaureate Primary Years Programme (source_url: https://eisschool.eu/en/home/). The official IB school directory can be searched for the school and country (source_url: https://www.ibo.org/programmes/find-an-ib-school/?SearchFields.Country=PL&SearchFields.Keywords=Einstein%20International%20School).

legal_admin.summary: A foreign newcomer living in Poland must register permanent residence or temporary residence exceeding three months at the municipality office where they live, no later than the 30th day of residence at that address (source_url: https://www.gov.pl/web/gov/zamelduj-sie-na-pobyt-staly-dla-cudzoziemcow-en).
legal_admin.registration_step: Submit the appropriate permanent- or temporary-residence registration form and supporting identity, residence-status and premises documents to Gdynia's municipality office; temporary registration applies when staying at the address for more than three months.

tax_finance.summary: For a non-business natural person who has a PESEL and is not VAT-registered or a tax/social-insurance payer, PESEL is the tax identifier and no identification filing is required. A person without PESEL, or one who conducts business, is VAT-registered, or is a tax/social-insurance payer, must submit an identification notification to obtain NIP; natural persons outside CEIDG use NIP-7 (source_url: https://www.podatki.gov.pl/abc-podatkow/rejestracja-podatnikow/).

transport.summary: ZKM Gdynia is the city public-transport organizer; its regular personalized monthly ticket for ordinary and night lines in the Gdynia fare zone costs PLN 103 (source_url: https://zkmgdynia.pl/taryfa/bilety-okresowe/). Driving-licence exchange depends on issuing country and residence duration (source_url: https://www.gov.pl/web/gov/wymien-zagraniczne-prawo-jazdy-na-polskie). A newcomer without another public-insurance basis can obtain voluntary NFZ cover through the regional NFZ branch and then ZUS (source_url: https://www.gov.pl/web/zdrowie/ubezpiecz-sie-dobrowolnie).
transport.network_name: Zarzad Komunikacji Miejskiej w Gdyni (ZKM Gdynia)
transport.driving_licence_exchange: A valid EU driving licence does not need exchange. A holder of another foreign licence who has lived in Poland for at least 185 days must exchange it; a licence not matching the Geneva or Vienna Convention model also requires passing the state theory test. Source: https://www.gov.pl/web/gov/wymien-zagraniczne-prawo-jazdy-na-polskie
transport.healthcare_registration: If not covered through another public-insurance basis, apply to the regional NFZ branch for voluntary health insurance, sign the contract, then file ZUS ZZA with the local ZUS office within 7 days. Source: https://www.gov.pl/web/zdrowie/ubezpiecz-sie-dobrowolnie
